test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ? # : EIC :: QLZ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : EIC :: QLZ : %

Option 1) # = FHD, % = PMY → FHD : EIC :: QLZ : PMY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599bb7a95279897d8170576ccf679b7ecd82c5154ccb334568075511c76bc9ba.png] 

Option 2) # = ERB, % = RNW → ERB : EIC :: QLZ : RNW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8d072e7fe8867fbacdc2a04ecab0168a8483030d0082bbf248ab80374e8293.png] 

Option 3) # = EDG, % = PNY → EDG : EIC :: QLZ : PNY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14f88db795d88f8f769a381de91700e3a898de66b402ee01abe2b9f94dad27d2.png] 

Option 4) # = DJF, % = UPV → DJF : EIC :: QLZ : UPV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a932569874d8ef97c470d22b6e68e502f6f9c0218dba7748a57f6b46b2aae6bd.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
